title: pulsatilla alpina subsp. alpicola
intro: Pulsatilla alpina subsp. alpicola, commonly known as the alpine pasque flower, is a plant species belonging to the ranunculaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pulsatilla alpina subsp. alpicola include its ability to soothe and calm the body, reducing stress and anxiety, as well as its potential to support respiratory health and ease coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
